natural_press.inactive_execution: left non-goal axes bounded static hold; right6 exact zero residual; no wrist teacher or phase action gate

initial_distribution.rng: official CPU torch RNG retained; aligned state at episode boundaries only

natural_press.likelihood: saved active4 independent Gaussian tanh latent; other35 channels excluded

aligned_start.reset: native arrived q/body and reconstructed compound guitar root; no historical state clock restoration
aligned_start.success_scope: conditional goal4, not free J33 song performance

journal.timing_scope: encode_s: row JSON/UTF8; compress_write_s: gzip create/write/finish; sync_s: file flush/fsync and initial directory sync; excludes metadata sidecar work; compressed_bytes is produced file bytes, not measured device IO; completed_members are closed and synced

decision_journal.timing_scope: encode_s: row JSON/UTF8; compress_write_s: gzip create/write/finish; sync_s: file flush/fsync and initial directory sync; excludes metadata sidecar work; compressed_bytes is produced file bytes, not measured device IO; completed_members are closed and synced

checkpoints.scope: all successful initial/periodic/final/recovery saves, including checkpoint fsync; save_s excludes manifest hashing/write

guitar_representation.proxy_collision_policy: G:thumb_support_proxy and G:pluck_range retain visuals and their original mass/COM/inertia contribution, but both geoms have contype=conaffinity=0. Intentional difference: their original possible chair/ground contacts are fully excluded. Original logical39 markers and source properties retained.

gpu_scene.state_setter_scope: Episode boundaries only; human DOF and free guitar root

hand_collision.external_pair_preservation: Checked against actual compound-guitar and chair filters; the two source guitar proxies have no physical shape in the GPU compound asset.
